quick_start._note: Quick start (user's playtest notes, 2026-11-13): the Start screen's Quick Start skips the configurator. A small map (map: configurator values; buildings: at least this many of each, mapgen building_min; town_near_base: one town this many hexes from the Player Base, mapgen town_near_base) in single map mode (XP rate, conscription), with the army already in squads instead of the opening Edit Units: squads squads of a Serf-line leader and stage2_per_squad Serf-line stage 2 units, each with at least front_min front-line and healer_min healer units, and large_squads of them with one Large race-line monster in place of a stage 2 unit (the user's map 1 outline, 2026-11-12); the recruit pool holds serfs Serfs and recruits Serf-line stage 2 units. One enemy field squad holds the town nearest the Player Base, as its garrison (it stays there), and that town has a shop.
quick_start._raiders: User, 2026-11-13 (too easy): one more enemy squad, built like the others, waits on open ground nearest the point midway between the bases; after raider_delay_ticks (4 game hours) it marches on the nearest town the player holds, or the Player Base if none, and takes it if unopposed. It falls back to recover like any enemy squad, then goes again.

single_map._note: Single map mode (user's design, 2026-11-10; configurator Game mode). The Opinion Leader starts alone in squad 1 on the map; everyone else starts in the recruit pool. base_slots replaces slot_growth.base for the player's squads. squad_cap_by_size: the configurator's default squads-on-the-map for the named map size nearest in area. pool: total units at the start (the Opinion Leader included); leaders = the squads-on-the-map cap + leaders_over_cap (user's notes, 2026-11-11), Serf-line stage 3 units that can lead, covering every Serf-line terrain before any repeats; stage 2 units fill whatever total leaves after leaders, large and serfs, from the Serf lines with at least front_min front-line and healer_min healer or support units (each capped at half the stage 2 count); large are distinct stage 1 Large race-line classes, none native to large_skip_terrains).

pool._scale: Multiplies every count below (leaders too) at the start; 1 = the 30-unit pool. Set to 2 on 2026-11-11 to see the far side of the balance point (user's notes).

conscription._note: SPEC 18, single map mode (user's design, 2026-11-10): taking a town (of town_types) for the first time sends recruits to that side's pool, once per side per town. Fighters are Serf-line stage 2 units at the median level of that side's squads; if the pool holds no unit that can lead, one fighter is a Serf-line leader instead. The enemy gets half the player's rate and no Serfs; its pool forms a new Warband at the Enemy Base whenever it holds warband_size units with a leader among them, while its squads number fewer than squad_cap x the starting count.

enemy_builds._note: Single map mode: each enemy squad's 4-unit build gets this many more random Serf-line stage 2 units (rows by their role), and enemy squads get base_slots slots, so they meet 6-unit player squads evenly (session 049).
